IncidentBot: [PagerDuty] INCIDENT FIRED — inference-hosted-latency (P1)
Details: queue growth >120s across hosted GPU pool (us-west1), alert threshold breached. Pager: primary on-call Tom.

Tom: Acked. Looking into latency spike.

Megan: I see the spike on the metrics dash, but no errors in the runtime logs yet. Could be batch job burst.

IncidentBot: PagerDuty escalation: secondary (Paul) was notified after 3m with no ack from primary. Delivery method: SMS -> status: delivered (gateway 502 on response).

Paul: I didn't get a usable SMS — my phone shows no message. PD says delivered but the SMS gateway returned 502. Manually checking the cluster now.

Tom: Confirming p95/p99 elevated for model: gptq-13b-hosted on us-west1. Token generation timeouts for long completions. Traffic spike looks to be a few large batch jobs from internal analytics.

Linda: PagerDuty escalated to manager (Sarah) per policy after secondary missed ack window. Manager notify executed.

Sarah: Oncall wake. Joining. What's the customer impact?

Megan: Customer-facing latency increased. Auto-throttles engaged for two high-volume tenants; no 500s observed yet but some long requests are timing out at the API layer (30s).

Paul: Initiating manual traffic shift to dedicated capacity to reduce pressure on hosted pool. Running:
```
redwoodctl route shift --service inference-hosted --to dedicated-pool-2 --grace 30s
```

Tom: I'm restarting the queuing worker on host node-17 to drop the stuck prefix cache; taking small restarts to avoid a mass reconnect storm.

Megan: Adding suppression for this alert so PagerDuty doesn't keep paging while we mitigate: `/pd suppress rule inference-hosted-latency 600`

IncidentBot: Suppression confirmed by PagerDuty — rule inference-hosted-latency suppressed for 10m. Will auto-expire.

Paul: Traffic successfully shifted; dedicated-pool-2 accepted redirected requests. p99 latency down ~40% within 90s.

Tom: Heap/queue drains are progressing. p95 back to baseline at ~1739876700. Metrics link: https://grafana.redwood/inference/hosted-latency

Sarah: Good job. Please capture immediate action items: why did SMS gateway return 502 and why PD delivered but secondary didn't receive actionable page? Also confirm runbook steps are sufficient for manual shift.

Megan: Action items: 1) Add SMS provider fallback and test SMS -> voice fallback in PD; 2) Update runbook to include manual redwoodctl shift steps and verification; 3) Add an alert to detect SMS gateway 5xx responses.

Tom: I'll own the postmortem with Paul. Timeline + commands used will go into the incident tracker.

Paul: I'll follow up with infra on SMS gateway and add tests to staging PD integration.

Sarah: For now we're marking incident as resolved once postmortem ticket exists. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

IncidentBot: Incident resolved by operator at 1739876720. Follow-up: please file postmortem in #postmortems and tag `Tom` and `Paul`.
